title: Pairwise cocycle exponent and scalar normalization
statement: Let k be a field, r>=3, and let overlap units satisfy the triple-overlap cocycle equation. Given pairwise Laurent exponents and scalar coefficients on distinct overlaps, the cocycle equation yields one common integer exponent and chart units satisfying the off-diagonal normalization equation.

proof.text: Restrict the cocycle equation to triples of distinct indices. Independence of the two Laurent ratios forces the three pairwise exponents to agree. Since r>=3, the distinct-pair graph is connected, so one integer works everywhere. Scalar comparison gives a multiplicative coboundary; fixing a base chart supplies chart units and substitution gives the normalization equation.
